food_composition_primary_source: USDA FSRG/FoodData Central FNDDS 2021-2023 raw files are present locally with SHA256 checksums.

beta_i_health_label_diagnostics.health_label_contradiction_policy: Exclude CLR-overlapping sample IDs with contradictory healthy and nonhealthy metadata evidence before deriving binary health labels or fitting the health index; do not adjudicate them to either class.

beta_i_interpretation_boundary: beta_i estimates health-index finite-difference response to nutrient-linked microbiome perturbations; it is not a causal nutrient effect.
boundary: Food composition is real USDA FNDDS-derived data; imputed nutrient vectors and beta calibration weights require explicit Methods boundaries.
